Maya: Heads up — stuck on a marketplace PO UAT failure for NebulaEdge. Portal returns "attachment header invalid" when we upload signed PO + invoice. Procurement says it's a formatting mismatch. Anyone seen this?
Ethan: which environment? screenshot?
Maya: UAT (sandbox-marketplace-us). Error: "400: EDI-HDR: missing ISA/GS envelope" Screenshot attached. But partner says they uploaded a PDF signed page.
Anika: :eyes: Our partner's portal expects an EDI envelope for POs over $50k. That's new. Marketplace onboarding doc didn't mention it. Ticket #MK-4321.
Jules: cc @Procurement Bot — can procurement accept a PDF-only workflow for initial onboarding?
Procurement Bot: Procurement: We need vendor to accept the "no assignment" redline removal before we can issue. Legal flagged clause 7.2.1 — vendor declined in SOW v2. Recommend accepting alternative clause: "assignment requires prior consent not to be unreasonably withheld." Need procurement review.
Ethan: also SI integration (Citadel SI) needs SAML metadata updated — their SSO is returning NameID in transient format; portal rejects because EDI header parser looks for stable identifiers. Reached out to SI.
Maya: partner is pushing go-live next week. Can we fallback to manual ingestion? I can generate EDI header if someone gives ISA/GS template.
Anika: I have a sample ISA/GS header from other partners. Pasting:
```
ISA*00*          *00*          *ZZ*REDWOOD         *ZZ*NEBULAEDGE       *210323*1253*U*00401*000000001*0*T*:~
GS*PO*REDWOOD*NEBULAEDGE*20210323*1253*1*X*004010~
```
Jules: Procurement — can we accept a signed PDF and Redwood ingest it manually for UAT while we sort legal with partner? That buys 48–72h.
Procurement Bot: Procurement: Manual ingestion allowed for sandbox only; must be logged and flagged. If legal redline remains unresolved for prod, we cannot approve. Please escalate legal thread with partner counsel.
Maya: ok I'll ask partner to provide signed PDF + export control attestation + contact for counsel. Also will request SI update. Assigning action items:
- Maya: request counsel contact and signed attestation (due EOD)
- Ethan: prep EDI/ISA template ingest script (ETA 24h)
- Anika: confirm sandbox manual ingestion runbook (ETA 12h)
- Jules: follow-up with Procurement to confirm manual ingest allowed
Anika: noted. I'll post runbook here once ready.
Ethan: starting script now. ping if you want to pair on ingestion tests.
marketplace-bot: deploy-bot: New ticket created MK-4321: marketplace-ingest-edi — assignee unassigned. Link: https://tickets.redwood.ai/MK-4321
Maya: Thanks team :pray: Will update once partner confirms counsel.
